implementation.behavior: executeDurableReceiptOcr accepts the safe release path only for the trusted GeminiOcrError class with definitiveCredentialRejection=true. Arbitrary lookalike sentinels, transport uncertainty, cancellation, response parsing or validation failures, and completion uncertainty retain the indeterminate replay fence.

A new forward migration adds a service-role-only public release wrapper, a postgres-owned private helper, and a private opaque idempotency ledger keyed by (result_id, claim_token). The exact active processing/possibly_dispatched claim is deleted when no prior payload exists or restored to succeeded/completed with the unchanged validated payload and revision after force refresh.

Repeated force-refresh credential rejection is supported for the same result_id with distinct claim tokens. A stale acknowledgement replay resolves only its original composite receipt and cannot mutate a newer claim. Wrong tokens, succeeded rows, uncertain rows, invalid retained payloads, and payloads whose provider/model/normalization do not match the durable binding remain unchanged.

A separate versioned recovery capability is checked before claim, quota reservation, and provider dispatch. The client accepts only the exact three-key v1 ready response; missing RPC, RPC error, held, malformed data, wrong version, or extra keys throws DurableReceiptOcrCapabilityHeldError with code FEATURE_DATABASE_HELD.

The existing daily quota limit and reservation charging policy are unchanged. A retry after repaired credentials may consume a new existing quota reservation. No refund, quota increase, or quota migration was added.

ordering.requirement: Apply and verify the existing held 89-to-105 chain first, then apply and verify this separately held 105-to-106 successor.

verification.command: PG17.11 disposable cluster: apply successor migration, then backend/supabase/tests/receipt_ocr_definitive_credential_rejection_release.sql
coverage: no-payload release and idempotent ACK replay
repeated refresh with stale ACK isolation

limits: The PostgreSQL fixture used a disposable local PostgreSQL 17.11 cluster with synthetic rows and a minimal predecessor harness. It proves SQL transaction, ACL, idempotency, restore and race behavior, not a hosted apply or a full operating-catalog replay.
The 105-to-106 successor remains held and unapplied. Local source and tests do not prove hosted function presence, runtime ACLs, deployment, or release completion.

HTTP, SSE and admin callers still need their owning source to map DurableReceiptOcrCapabilityHeldError to the fixed FEATURE_DATABASE_HELD response. The owned helper already stops before claim, quota reservation and provider dispatch.
Global parity and build are intentionally delegated to the root integration pass.
